projects.title: Care Comes From Nature
projects.description:
Teamra is a distribution company that sells organic and herbal cosmetics, offering customers natural alternatives for personal care.Teamra entered the market in 2002 and soon opened other stores besides Tirana, in Elbasan and Saranda.

Teamra asked us to manage their social media in order to promote all their products in a more creative way.

Through the posts and creative illustrations we made for them, we gave this company a special spirit and made their social networks more active; in this way, we also informed the audience about the special products that Teamra markets.
